connector.name: Forge
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Forge, Voxell's hosted text-embedding API. Tools: embed and list_models.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package forge-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.voxell. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FORGE_API_KEY
env.description: Your Forge API key — create one at https://dash.voxell.ai (free tokens to start, no card).
